basic_info.description: Sophisticated 2-level condo in vibrant Lower Pacific Heights! This well-maintained 1BD/1.5BA residence offers 793 sq ft of thoughtfully designed space with hardwood floors, custom window treatments, and a functional layout ideal for modern living. The main level features a spacious living and dining area, a stylish kitchen with quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances, and a convenient half bath. A private patio expands the living space outdoors.    Upstairs, the bedroom suite offers great separation of space, ample closet storage, and a well-appointed ensuite bath. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry and 1-car garage parking.    Community amenities include a fitness center, club room, secure bike storage, and a rooftop terrace with sweeping viewsperfect for relaxing or hosting friends. With close proximity to Fillmore Street dining, Japantown, grocery stores, and tech shuttle stops, this location offers a connected lifestyle. Enjoy easy access to downtown and beyond in a neighborhood where culture, convenience, and community come together.
